title: THE SHIP GLOW NEVER CRASHES THE FRAME
why: The inbound ship glow radius is 60 plus 70 times how far the countdown has run. With the extract wait cut from 30 to 20 on 10-28, a countdown longer than the wait made that number negative and the canvas threw, which stops the whole frame. Clamped to 0 to 1. Found by check 34.89, which staged 40 against a wait of 20.
now: The ship glow cannot throw when the countdown is longer than the extract wait.

edits.replacement: var urg=inb?clamp(1-Math.max(0,G.beaconT)/Math.max(1,CFG.extractWait),0,1):0;   // v28.xx (cw-urgclamp): the beacon glow radius is 60+70*urg; a countdown longer than the wait (the wait went 30 to 20 on 10-28) made urg negative and arc threw, stopping the frame
